_readme: Exposure decisions for the tool parity audit (scripts/tool-parity.mjs). Every tool visible on any surface (MCP bridge / playground agent / @pyric/cli registry) must be recorded here as 'gap' (absence is a defect to fix) or 'deliberate' (absence is design, with the reason). Unannotated tools fail `bun run tool:parity --check`. Seeded from docs/design/TOOL-SYSTEM.md's exposure matrix.

inspect_firestore_traffic.reason: missing from MCP — an external agent debugging rules needs the same visibility the playground agent has

inspect_denial.reason: missing from MCP — the killer feature must be reachable from Claude Code

try_rules_edit.reason: missing from MCP — rules iteration from an external agent is a core story

generate_fixture_from_session.reason: missing from MCP — pairs with `pyric verify`, an external-agent workflow

simulate_firestore_write.reason: ok per TOOL-SYSTEM.md — exposed via bridge rules tools (firestore_simulate_rules) and the playground diagnostic; verify arg parity between the two implementations

list_files.reason: workspace file tool, playground-only — external agents have their own filesystem; exposing a second one invites split-brain
